biggest_catch: The $150 bonus requires a 2-year fixed or mixed electricity + natural gas bundle (single fuel only gets $75), and the credit lands up to 90 days after activation — it applies to energy charges only, not delivery or regulated fees.
catches: Alberta only — ATCO Energy is a competitive retailer in Alberta, Canada.
New customers only: you must not have had an active site with ATCO Energy in the last 6 months.
Bonus applies to energy charges only; delivery charges, government fees and other regulated charges still apply.
Credit is applied within 90 days of activation, not immediately.
$150 requires enrolling in the 2-year fixed or mixed dual-fuel bundle; electricity or gas alone gets $75.

steps: Go to atcoenergy.com and shop the home energy plans.
Choose the 2-year fixed or mixed electricity and natural gas bundle (for the $150 bonus) or a single-fuel plan (for the $75 bonus).
Sign up online or by phone as a new customer (ATCO says signup takes about 10 minutes).
Your site is activated and electricity/gas starts flowing; ATCO handles the switch from your current provider.
The welcome bonus credit is applied to your bill within 90 days of activation.
timing: Welcome bonus credit applied to the bill within 90 days of site activation.
